Commentary.Commentary: Lakmal bowled his heart out, taking a 5-fer but it was Lahiru Kumara who bowled with fire. The rest were not all that impressive. 6 overs left in the day. Can Sri Lanka see them off without damage? Here come the openers...

A decent batting display by the Australians. Harris played a dodged knock, seeing off the difficult period last evening and then knocks by Head, Labuschagne and Patterson. The latter two impressed the most, playing 'correct' cricket with the right technique and having loads of patience. Head, meanwhile, was flirting with his luck.

Harsh to say so. The pitch is not all that difficult to bat but it is the ball - if it moves, then Starc will talk. And if the latest member of the 200-club starts to talk, well, Sri Lanka will not be left with much to talk.
Sri Lanka made 144. Australia lead by 179. Does that mean an innings defeat is on the cards?

OUT! The last wicket falls! A bit like the last ball but this time Richardson has chipped it in the air. Flighted one on off, Jhye skips down the track and tries playing across the line. But it catches the leading edge and loops in the air. Karunaratne moves across to his left from covers and takes a tumbling catch. Australia all out for 323!
Advances down the track, is deceived in flight but does well to keep it out safely on the off side. Jhye should just look to give the strike back to Starc.

FOUR! There was a second fielder down there in the deep on the leg side but not anymore before this ball but the pink ball is. Fine, fine flick shot off the pads by Starc. It's full and begging to be put away. A boundary to end the over, 11 from the over and the lead is now 179!

SIX! Fireworks from Starc's bat! First biggie of the innings. Lakmal hurls one right in the slot for Starc, it's full around middle, Mitchell clears his front foot and towers it over long on for a biggie. 14 off last 7 balls for Mitchell.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

First run in Test cricket for Richardson. Not in a convincing manner but he's a number 11 batsman. An away swinger, around off, Richardson pushes at it with the intention to play through covers probably but slices it off the outer half to point. A single taken.
Full and outside off, beaten on the drive.
Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Jhye tries to flick but misses. He is hit on the thigh pad.
Full and on off, Starc drives it straight back and it deflects off Jhye's bat to mid off. The mid on fielder mops it up, the batsmen decide not to cross.
Goes down on one knee for a big heave across the line but fails to connect this time.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! And again! Starc has decided to cut loose now. Another slog sweep by him. In the same region towards fine leg. The fielder in the deep is standing a shade up and it flies over him. Drops just ahead of the rope before crossing it. Starc just loves his slog sweeps.

FOUR! Lovely shot! Starc usually prefers slogging over mid-wicket but he has dismissed this one over short fine leg. An arm ball, going down, Starc plays it with the angle and connects nicely. A boundary results.

Appeal for an lbw! Perera delivers an arm ball on middle and leg, skidding in, Starc gets back to defend but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The replays later on show that there was an inside edge.
Fullish outside off, pushed out to point to end the over.
Slips a full ball down the leg side, Richardson tries flicking but misses.
Jhye Richardson is the last batsman.

OUT! Plumb in front! No help from the technology for the debutant. A Test fifer for Lakmal, his third overall. Another inswinger from him to hunt down a batsman. He lands it on a length around middle and the ball nips back in off the seam. Patterson is caught napping inside the crease with his footwork, tries playing it straight but it shapes back in to rap him on the pads. The finger goes up as soon as the appeal is made. Kurtis takes the DRS but the replays show that it has hit him in line and is going on to disturb the leg pole. A knock of 30 but the young man showed good promise.
OUT! Dead plumb. This looks stone dead. But Patterson wants to see if he can change that LBW call. Looks very, very difficult...
Fullish and on middle, Starc gets forward and gently pushes at it with a straight bat. It gathers the inside half of his bat and goes through square leg for one.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Kurtis gets back to punch it through the line but it takes the inside edge and rolls to fine leg for a run.
Fuller and on off, angling away, Patterson guards his stumps and shoulders arms.
Full and on off at 82.7 kph, Starc drives it back to the bowler.
Beaten! This one is bowled slower through the air around off. Starc strides forward to defend but it spins away a bit to beat the outside edge.
Sliding down the leg side, Starc gets forward and pads it away.
A touch short and on off, Starc gets back and defends it towards point.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Loopy and full on off, Starc lunges and defends it back.

Will Pucovski comes on to the field. Thoughts of declaration? He gives some drinks to Starc and then has a long chat. Surely the Aussies have enough on the board. Might do their fast bowlers a world of good in terms of confidence if they get a chance to bowl in helpful conditions...
Keeps probing on and around off, getting it to move away from the batsman, Patterson leaves it alone. Two maidens in a row after a 15-run over.
Wicket to wicket line, on a length, Patterson covers his stumps and brings down a straight bat in defense.
Pitches it up and around middle and off, Patterson drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Identical to the last delivery, just a bit behind the fuller length. Angling across the batsman and Kurtis allows it through.
Tries to tempt the batsman by bowling it on a driving length outside off. Patterson shows patience as he makes a leave.
Good length delivery on middle, Patterson remains on the back foot and pushes it towards the bowler.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack. He is one away from a fifer. Can he get it in this spell?
Arm ball on middle, skidding down, Starc helps it off his pads to square leg.
Fires one in on middle, Starc keeps it out back to the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, Starc stays back and punches it in the direction of the bowler.
Sliding down the leg side, Starc works it off his pads to square leg.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
FOUR! Boom! Just a touch short in length around off, Patterson camps back and packs a punch through covers. No stopping this one. 15 from the over, 300 up for Australia.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

Short ball on off, rising onto the batsman at 128.6 kph, Starc gets back to fend at it and gloves it on the leg side. It rolls towards short leg, Mitchell has no idea initially where the ball is and his partner calls him through for a run.
Turns a full ball in the gap at mid-wicket and takes a run.
Full and angling in on off, Patterson is forward in defense towards mid off. The fielder there makes a sliding stop. Called a no ball for overstepping.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Patterson. First he shows how good he is behind square leg and now he displays his talent in front of square on the off side. Stays back to a shortish ball outside off and crunches it through the left side of the cover-point fielder for a boundary. 150 is the lead now!
Square leg drops back.
FOUR! Fine shot! First boundary for the debutant! Chameera digs in a short ball on middle, Patterson swivels on the back foot and pulls it nicely behind square leg for a glorious boundary.
Moves back and gently plays it in the gap at mid-wicket. Starc knows how well he has hit it and returns for the second run before the fielder in the deep gets to the ball. Good judgement.
Loopy and on off, Patterson drives it with the turn through the cover region for one.
Loopy full ball on middle, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on off, Kurtis gets back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Flighted and around off, Patterson advances down the track and tries to defend. But it takes the inside edge and flies off his pads to the off side. Falls in no man's land at cover-point.
Short in length and outside off, Patterson cuts it through point and comes back for the second run.
FOUR! Crashes the first ball he faces. Chameera provides width and Starc pounces onto it outside his off stump and spanks it through covers.
Mitchell Starc is the new batsman.

OUT! This one was always on the cards. A 21-ball duck for Pat Cummins. This delivery is really unplayable. Chameera has bowled a gem here. Bowls a length ball in the line of the stumps and gets it to move away a hint on pitching. Cummins tries playing the line but it takes a thick outside edge. Dickwella makes no mistake behind the stumps and the struggle is over for Pat. Australia lead by 134 runs.
Play and a miss! An away swinger outside off, Cummins is lured into the shot and misses.

Full and on off, angling in, Patterson plants his front foot forward and bunts it towards mid-wicket for a quick single. Lakmal attacks the ball but misses his shy at the striker's end. Mendis does well to back the throw with a dive coming in from second slip.
Angles in a length ball from outside off, Kurtis taps it down to the off side, looks for a run initially but then aborts it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Patterson covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Slower through the air, full and dipping in on middle, Patterson flicks it through mid-wicket and collects a run.
Loopy and full on off, Patterson lunges and defends it to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Spin and bounce, but down the leg side. Pat fails to flick and Dickwella also fails to collect it behind the wickets. They take a bye.
Floated full around leg, Kurtis tries to sweep but fails to connect. It deflects off his pads to square leg and they steal a leg bye.
Flatter and shorter on off, Patterson punches it from the crease to covers.
Chameera bowls this one wide of the crease and lands it on a length outside off, Cummins pokes at it flat-footed and is beaten due to the away movement.
Serves it on a driving length outside off, Cummins lets it be. There is a leg slip in place now. So, we can expect a surprise short ball any time.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, shaping away, Pat allows it through again.
Bowls it on a length and outside off, Cummins makes a leave.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! Chameera is back on the field and delivers an inswinger from a good length around off. Cummins offers no shot and takes it on his pads. Too high.
Tossed up and outside off, left alone to end the over.
Loopy and on off, fuller in length, Patterson lunges and defends it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Quicker one angling into the batsman, Patterson advances down the track to play the flick but misses. It goes off his pads to point. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Dushmantha Chameera is heading back to the tunnel. Kusal Perera is on for him.
Beauty! Chameera angles in a length ball on off and it shapes away after landing, Cummins is forward as he pushes inside the line but gets beaten.
Hurls in a good length delivery in the corridor outside off, Cummins makes an easy leave.
Switches to 'round the wicket now and angles in a length ball on off. Patterson is on the front foot as he pushes it to the off side. It rolls in the gap at covers and they cross for a single.
Angling away from the southpaw, it's outside off and Patterson has nothing to do with it.
A length ball on middle, Patterson brings down a straight bat in defense.
Good length ball on off, blocked from the crease.
Dushmantha Chameera comes back into the attack. Meanwhile, Suranga Lakmal is seen leaving the field. Comfort break? Or another injury? The way he ran in, looks like the former.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nearly carries to short leg. Full and around off, spinning in, Cummins gets forward to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes on one bounce to short leg.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.
Slow spin back into the batsman from outside off, Cummins goes back and pushes it out to short mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, spinning away a shade after hitting one of the cracks, Patterson gets back to flick but it takes the leading edge and goes to point.
Angles in a full ball on off, Cummins is confidently forward as he defends it back.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, Pat allows it through.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Appeal for a caught behind! Not given. Full and outside off, shaping away, Cummins is sucked into the drive but it moves away to beat the outside edge. They appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. There are six slip fielders behind waiting for any edge. Attacking from Dinesh Chandimal.
Beauty! This is the delivery he should have bowled. Angling in around off, on a length and getting it to straighten, Cummins can't do much there. Tries to defend and is lucky not to have edged it.

No hat-trick! Lakmal bowls it wide and outside off, short in length, Lakmal allows it through. Not the kind of delivery you will bowl when on a hat-trick. We saw Roach doing the same yesterday when on a hat-trick against England.
Hat-trick ball...
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated on middle, Patterson comes down the track and hits it to mid-wicket.
Quicker delivery on off, Kurtis defends it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Patterson defends off the back foot.
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pat Cummins is the new batsman.

OUT! The catch is fine and Tim Paine bags a golden duck. What a ball to get first up! A peach by Lakmal. He dishes out a back of a length ball around off and gets it to swerve away and Paine is caught on the back foot flirting inside the line. He gets squared up completely and the extra bounce catches the outside edge. It's dying in front of second slip but Mendis does well to go down low and snap it inches above the surface. He is running in celebration and the umpire has referred it upstairs. It's a clean catch in the replays and Paine has to depart. Kusal took a similar catch earlier in the day. Superb effort!

Tim Paine is gone first ball! But the umpire wants to check whether Kusal Mendis has grabbed that low catch cleanly or not. He is up and running in celebration, very sure that he has pouched it. Let's see the replays...
Skipper Tim Paine is in next.

OUT! It's high but not high enough to miss the top of leg stump. It's clipping and umpire's call stays! Head has to walk back and he will feel that he missed out on a golden opportunity to get his maiden Test hundred. Lakmal with his third wicket here. He bowls a good length ball on off and it nips back in after hitting the deck. Head strides ahead and across to flick it across the line but misses and is trapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Head takes the DRS thinking that it hit him high on the knee-roll but the replays roll in to disappoint him. End of a scratchy knock by Travis but he gusted out there and deserved the three-digit score.
Shout for an lbw! The finger goes up and Travis Head takes the DRS. Is height the factor there?
Square leg drops back.
Lakmal goes short around off, Travis immediately goes on his toes to play the pull shot but it takes the inner half of his bat and rolls to mid on.

Angling away from the batsman, on a good length, Head keeps his weight on the back foot and punches it in front of square on the off side. The cover-point fielder moves across to stop the ball and they take a couple of runs. Good calling by Head.
Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Kurtis tries to flick but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to backward square leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Good length delivery on off, Patterson gets behind the line, stays back and pushes it in the direction of the mid off fielder.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on the field but Lahiru Kumara continues to be off. Meanwhile, Lakmal to continue...
Perera hurls it in outside off, the length is short and Head picks it quickly. Goes back and cuts it wide of backward point for a couple of runs.
Loopy one, landing full on off, Head lunges and defends it back with a straight bat.
Full and flighted on off, Travis jumps out of the crease and pushes it to covers.
Tossed up ball around off, going straight on, Head covers the stumps and allows it through.
Once again use of the feet, this time by Head. He pushes it down the ground but straight to mid on.
Good use of the feet there by Patterson. He dances down the track to reach the pitch of the ball and flicks it wide of mid on for a run.
FOUR! Cracking shot! A fractionally short of a length delivery around off, Travis Head rocks back and smashes it through cover-point for a boundary.
Lakmal loses his radar this time and slips a length ball down the leg side. Head has no chance of flicking and Dickwella does well to dive across to his right to collect the ball.

Some considerable movement on this delivery. Lakmal lands it on a length outside off and it nips back in off the seam. Head does well to play it across the line towards mid on. He didn't overcommit himself on the front foot.
Good length ball landing on off and angling down the leg side, Head tries flicking but misses and is hit on the pads.
This time the length is full and it has been angled in around off, Head is drawn forward as he pushes it gently to cover-point.
Lakmal continues from 'round the wicket and bowls a short delivery outside off, Head cuts it from the back foot but finds the point fielder.
A quicker one on the pads, flicked across the line but straight to square leg.
A good-looking cover drive off the front foot by Patterson but he finds the fielder.
Flatter and firing in on middle, Patterson flicks it to short leg and it goes off the fielder to square leg.
Skidding down from middle, Head moves back and helps it through square leg for a run.
Full floated on off, Head leans forward and drives it back. Perera moves across to his right to make the stop.
Perera angles it in from middle, Head gets back and taps it down in front of short leg. He makes a half stop and parries it to short mid-wicket.
Dilruwan Perera is forced to return. 22-5-65-1 so far.
Good length delivery on off, Kurtis defends off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Patterson lets it go.
Good length delivery on off, Patterson blocks it well.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good length delivery on off, it swung late, Patterson looks to go on the back foot but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Short of a length delivery, Head punches it between cover and point. The batsmen get three runs.
Problems. Dushmantha Chameera is going off the field. Already Lahiru Kumara is off. This might be a long, long, long evening for the Lankans.
Bowls down the leg side, Patterson looks to go after it but misses it.
Outside off, Patterson does not bother to play at it.
Good length delivery outside off, Kurtis looks to cut but gets beaten by the away movement.
Good length delivery on off, Patterson easily keeps it out.
Length delivery on off, Head taps it towards covers for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Head leaves it alone.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Down the leg side, flick shot missed.

Comes from round the wicket. Back of a length delivery on off, Patterson cuts it through point. The fielder chases it and slides and stops it comfortably. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Length delivery on leg, Kurtis flicks it to the leg side.
Good length delivery on off, Patterson keeps it out.
Suranga Lakmal changes ends. 19-7-50-2 so far.
Good shape on this one. Good length delivery outside off, Travis lets it go.
Good length delivery on off, Travis defends off the back foot.
Length delivery on middle, Head tucks it to the leg side.
A length ball on middle, Kurtis tucks it through square leg where Roshen Silva dives to his right but it goes through. Fine leg mops it up but the batsmen take three.
Full on middle, Patterson drives it towards the bowler who gets a hand to it and it goes past him to mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Patterson lets it go.
Dushmantha Chameera to bowl from the other end.

OFF THE MARK IN TEST CRICKET! That will settle some of the nerves. Full and around middle, Patterson pushes it past the bowler towards mid on, takes the fielder on and completes his first ever run in international cricket. 250 UP FOR AUSTRALIA. The lead is now 106.
Floated on off, Kurtis looks to defend but gets hit on the pads.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery on off, Patterson looks to defend but gets beaten on this one.
On a length around off, watchfully defended.
Tossed up on middle, Patterson keeps it out.

Aha. Highly anticipated session. Pink ball. Under lights. Boy, we could be in for some fun. The players are out in the middle. Not exactly dark yet, there is still plenty of sunshine on offer. Here is Dilruwan Perera to start off proceedings after Dinner. The debutant Patterson to face. Here we go...
... DAY 2, FINAL SESSION ...

Australia well, for what seems for them once in a blue moon, are on top. This is a nice opportunity for the newbies to get a big score and grind the opposition. Join us back at 6 pm local (0800 GMT) for the final rites of the day.

What is disappointing for Sri Lanka is the way they played in this session. They nearly struck in the first over after Tea but Dickwella could not get that chance. Post that, it has been a series of poor deliveries and poor fielding efforts. The bowling looks ragged as well.

Fantastic session for Australia. 90 runs in 30 overs for the loss of just Labuschagne. The lead is now 105 and one just feels that another good hour for the home side and that might be it for the Lankans.
Full on middle, Head drives it back towards  the bowler. THAT IS DINNER ON DAY 2.
Good length delivery outside off, Head lets it go.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full on leg, Patterson looks to flick but gets it off his pads. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen take a single. Umpire gives it as leg bye.
Again on a good length on off, Patterson defends off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Patterson shoulders his arms to this one.
SECOND NEW BALL HAS BEEN TAKEN. Suranga Lakmal to make the first use of the same. 18-6-50-2 so far. Should bowl the only over before Dinner.
Tossed up on off, Travis keeps it out.
Comes down the track but blocks.
Tossed up on off, Head blocks it well.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Floated on middle, Patterson comes down the track but gets an inside edge to short mid-wicket.
Bowls full on off, Kurtis keeps it out.
Outside off, left alone.
Flighted delivery on middle, Patterson defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Patterson keeps it out.
Kurtis Patterson, the debutant, walks out to bat.

OUT! Soft, softer, softest dismissal! Labuschagne cannot believe it. The crowd is stunned. Now it realizes. Starts to applaud the youngster's effort. He has missed out on a deserving hundred. Out of nowhere, Sri Lanka have picked up a wicket, with the new ball just 1.5 overs away. Full and around off, Marnus comes down the track and looks to chip it to the on side. Unfortunately for him, it goes straight to silly mid on where Lahiru Thirimanne does the formalities. Such a shame for the Aussie lad. He was looking so good. Now he is looking distraught. The 166-run stand is broken.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.

Big shout for caught behind! NOT OUT! Flighted delivery on off, Head comes ahead and looks to cut but misses it. Dickwella roars an appeal and dramatizes it. But the umpire shakes his head. Nothing conclusive from the replays.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and down the leg side, paddled through fine leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Head tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Full on off, Labuschagne drives it towards covers for a single.

TOUGH LUCK! Stupendous effort but in vain. Short and outside off, Labuschagne punches it through point. The fielder gets to the ball, dives and pulls it back in. But by the time the poor soul returns the ball, the batsmen RUN ALL FOUR!
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Floated on off, Head punches it towards mid off for a single.
Full toss on leg, Labuschagne flicks it towards mid on for a single. Short mid-wicket dives to his left and it goes through him.
Dhananjaya de Silva returns. 6-2-15-0 so far.
Full and outside off, Head come down the track and defends it towards mid off.
Short and outside off, finds point again with his cut shot.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Thick inside edge by the batsman, ball goes down to fine leg.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They manage to come back for the second.
Outside off, left alone.
2 runs.
1 run.
1 run.

HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Length delivery on middle, Labuschagne comes forward to defend but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka don't have reviews left in the innings. Hot Spot detects an inside edge. Snicko also confirms.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Labuschagne lunges to defend but is beaten. Extra bounce.
Short on off, Head looks to cut but it goes of the inner half of the bat to point.
Tossed up on off, Labushagne plays it towards covers for a single.

NOT OUT. Missing leg. Sri Lanka lose both their reviews. Full and around off, Labuschagne looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Perera is confident and convinces his skipper to go for the review, when he sees the umpire shake his head on the appeal. Tough luck. Out of reviews. Out of luck. Going out of the game as well...
LBW review against Labuschagne! Sri Lanka seem sure this is gone. How far was he down the track?

Another misfield. This is going all pear-shaped now. The substitute Sadeera Samarawickrama it is. Full and outside off, Head drives it towards mid off where Sadeera gets to the ball but is bounces off his left hand and goes behind.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid-wicket for a single. 150-RUN STAND IS UP!
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
FOUR! Good shot. Second boundary of the over. Short on off, Head cuts it through point. The fielder dives to his left at backward point and it goes through him for a boundary.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Karunaratne. Full on leg, Travis flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary. The fielder at fine leg dives but parries it into the fence.
Comes down the track and blocks it towards mid on.
Length delivery on off, Head keeps it out.
Almost! Full and outside off, TH comes down the track but is beaten in flight. Almost misses the ball but manages to thrust his pad out and push the ball past slip towards third man. A leg bye taken.
And again! Head is simply not able to find gaps. Comes out once more, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives. But finds short extra cover.
Comes down the track again and drives but finds extra cover this time!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Full and around off, Head comes down the track and drives it straight to mid on.
Short and outside off, cut straight to cover.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Short and outside off, punched through point for a couple.
Full and around middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
In line of the stumps, watchfully defended.
Short and outside off, placed straight to point.
Landed outside off, left alone.

DRINKS BREAK! This passage of play has again gone in the favour of the hosts. They have batted well and rarely played a loose shot. Travis Head is looking more confident now and is on the verge of scoring a big one while Labuschagne is batting well at the other end. The visitors have not been able to apply brakes in the scoring and would like to come with some fire after the break. Who will go ahead into the Dinner break? Desperate times. Dimuth Karunaratne has been called on to bowl with 10 overs to go to the second new ball.
Floated on middle, Travis comes down the track and plays it back towards the bowler.
Full again, watchfully blocked out.
Tossed up on off, Head comes down the track and drives it to short cover.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Fullish, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Tossed up on middle, Head goes back and plays it back towards the bowler.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
FOUR! Half tracker from Dhananjaya. Short delivery on middle, Head pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. There was no fielder in the deep.
Tossed up on off, Travis comes forward to defend.
Comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and down the leg side, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Pushes this straight to cover.
The batsman has driven it through mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Head comes down the track and hits it towards covers where Roshen Silva misfields and allows the batsmen an easy single.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Full on middle, Labuschagne comes down the track and hits it straight past the bowler through mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Short on off, Head cuts it to point.
Nicely played. Full and around middle, Labuschagne gets down and sweeps it through fine leg for one.
Floated on leg, Labuschagne tucks it to short leg.

Full and around off, Head dances down the track and thrashes it down the ground through mid on. Mid off gets to it, but before it is about to touch the ropes. He slides across and saves a run for his side.
Flighted delivery on off, Travis comes down the track and plays it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Labuschagne drives it through mid off. Three runs taken.
Floated on off, Travis keeps it out.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Labuschagne comes down the track and hits it to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, Marnus defends off the front foot.
Full and down the leg side, this is swept fine for a single.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Dilruwan Perera returns. 13-3-51-1 so far. 15 more overs left for the second new strawberry.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full on off, Labuschagne plays it to mid off.

HALF CENTURY FOR HEAD! Cannot honestly say it has been a wonderful innings. But he will take it. Australia will take it. His 4th half century in Tests. Gets to the landmark with a drive through the covers for a single. The 200 comes up as well.
Floated on off, Head defends off the front foot.
Full and around off, Head drives it back to the bowler who dives to his right to make an excellent stop.
Flighted delivery on off, Travis taps it to cover.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
A short ball outside off, punched through square leg for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, defended from the crease.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
A length ball down the leg side, Labuschagne looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball goes off his thighs towards fine leg and a leg bye is taken.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and around off, Travis jumps down the track and wrists it towards mid on.
Outside off, fired through, left alone.
Comes down the track, takes it on the full, drives it even harder but straight to mid off. Wants the single but has to return.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards mid off.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and around off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
A bouncer on off, Marnus ducks.
Outside off, left alone.
Beauty. On a good length outside off, Labuschagne looks to defend but the ball moves away off the seam, then straightens a touch and beats the outside edge.
On a length outside off, placed towards cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off again, left alone this time.
Outside off, gripping away, Travis adjusts and pushes it towards point.
This time he goes back and punches it towards the bowler.
Full and around middle, Head looks to defend but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards short leg.

DRINKS BREAK! It has been a good passage of play for Australia. They have not lost a wicket and have looked calm and composed with their batting. Sri Lanka on the other hand, have not picked up a wicket but there have been some close calls. Travis Head got a life in the first over after Tea but Dickwella spilled the chance. It was crucial at that time for the visitors to put pressure again on the Aussie batsmen. Will they be forced to pay the price for it? Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl now.
Bowls a bumper, Marnus does well to duck under it.
Length delivery on off, Head taps it towards covers for a single.
Short of a length delivery, Labuschagne pulls it over mid-wicket. The batsmen get just a single.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
On a good length around off, solidly defended back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and blocks.
Full and down the leg side, swept fine for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Half shout for lbw! NOT OUT! Flighted delivery on leg, Labuschagne looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Probably impact was outside leg.
FOUR! MAIDEN HALF CENTURY IN TESTS FOR LABUSCHAGNE! In his 6th innings.
Full on middle, worked wide of mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.

Beautiful shot, excellent stop. Full and wide outside off, Head leans into this and drives it through the covers. Lahiru Kumara chases the ball and manages to haul it back in, before he can touch the ropes. Three runs taken.
Full on off, Head drives it straight back towards the bowler where Chameera does well to stop it and it goes past his hands to the mid off region.

FOUR! 100-RUN STAND IS UP! It has been a tricky partnership but it has survived. Could have been broken but it is still going strong. Short and outside off, Head latches on to the cut and gets it behind point for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and around off, Head looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on. 11-1-30-0 so far.
Another sweep shot played, this time through square leg for a couple.
Outside off, punched through the off side for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full and down the leg side, swept through fine leg for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On middle and leg, flicked to the leg side.

FOUR! MARVELLOUS! In between his flashy shots, Head has shown his class as well. Full and outside off, Travis leans and drives it down the ground. Mid off dives to his left but the ball speeds through. The lead moves to 32.
Around off, solidly defended.
Full on middle and off, worked against the line through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, left alone.

APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Hmmm... looks close on the replays. Flighted delivery on off, Travis comes down the track to defend but gets hit on the pads. Perera appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka don't go for the review. Over to the Hawk Eye for our benefit. It shows that the impact was outside off and it would have been umpire's call in terms of hitting the stumps. Interesting observation from Michael Hussey on air though. He reckons that even though the impact is shown to be outside off, Travis had his bat behind the line - which means, impact does not matter. So... could have been given out.
Short delivery, Travis cuts it to point.
Tossed up on middle, Marnus flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, Head drives it through mid on. Lakmal chases from mid on and stops it just before the ropes. Brilliant fielding from Suranga Lakmal. The batsmen get three runs.
Floated on middle, Head flicks it to the leg side.
Tossed up on off, Labuschagne drives it through covers. The fielder chases it and stops it comfortably. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Length delivery on middle, Travis tucks it to the leg side.
Good length delivery on off, Head defends off the front foot.
Full on middle, Labuschagne flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
One more leave outside off.
Left alone again.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and just outside off, watchfully pushed back.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.

EDGED AND TAKEN! NO, NOT TAKEN! A let-off. A big let-off. The opportunity came but it has not been accepted. Good length delivery outside off, Head looks to defend but gets an outside edge due to the away movement. It goes towards first slip but Dickwella dived and had gone with one hand to take the catch but spills it. It was a tough catch. First slip would have taken it easily to his right. It would have been a crucial wicket in the context of the game. Travis Head gets a life.
Full and outside off, Labuschagne drives this through the covers for three.
Landed outside off, left alone.

The best time to bat in a Day-Night Test. Australia will hope to score runs and up that run rate. Wickets can probably put a question mark on that thought. Suranga Lakmal to set the question paper first up, to Marnus Labuschagne.
... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ...

Hard to fault the Sri Lankan bowlers for picking up just 2 wickets. But such is the state of the game. They need to keep on trying. Kumara was the pick of the lot with his pace while Lakmal was accurate. Can that pressure be created again? The Lankans will be looking to break this partnership and try and finish the innings off before Dinner. Probably try and limit the lead under 100. Australia, on the other hand, would be hoping that at least one of Head or Labuschagne is there at the crease when the pink ball is bowled under lights. Stay tuned...

So Labuschagne bid his time, soaked in the pressure and then slowly but surely, started to score. He was on 10 from 46 balls at one stage. Now he is on 36 from 80. That turn in momentum was brought about by him and the hosts are feeling confident because of his sponge-like ability to soak all the pressure. Oz are lucky that they did not lose more than 2 wickets in this session. Head was playing with his body on the frying pan and on fire, with too many loose shots. Got a few edges but all fell safe. Crucially for the home side, he looks set now.

If I would have been playing on my gaming console, Australia would have been all out by now. But as they say in cricket, one needs to understand the situation. Respect when the going is tough and then capitalize when it gets a bit easier. Marnus Labuschagne has been that bright student in the class who comes first and answers all his teacher's questions. Good boy.

What is Test cricket? A test of one's character. Be it a batsman or a bowler. Marcus Harris scored a boundary off the fifth ball of the afternoon. The next 10 overs yielded just 23 with 2 wickets. That has how it has been. Tough. Competitive. Sri Lanka gave it their all, keeping Australia busy. The tight lines and lengths did not waiver much and the hosts were in a pool of trouble. But then, eventually, the pressure started to ease off.

26 overs, 87 runs, 2 wickets. If you are switching on just now, you will have a look at the scorecard and say, ahh... normal scenario. Australia will score 400 and win this by an innings. Bad bowling from Sri Lanka. Well, actually, that has not been the case.
Full and outside off, left alone. TEA ON DAY 2, AUSTRALIA LEAD BY 15!
Outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, helped towards square leg for a quick run.
The length goes shorter and immediately Marnus goes back. Punches it through the covers for a couple.

FOUR! There comes the sweep again. The ball is pitched outside leg, Labuschagne gets his front foot out of the way, goes down and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Moves to 33. The lead is now 12.
Landed outside off, Labuschagne opens the face of his bat and guides it straight to short third man.
Looks like we will have one more over...
Full and fast outside off, let through.
Straight one, skids on, defended back to the bowler.
That is a short one which does not turn, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full and down the leg side, Marnus misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and down the leg side, swept fine for a couple.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Comes down the track and pushes it through mid off. Suranga Lakmal dives to his right but fumbles. A single taken.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Full and around off, pushed towards the bowler.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Down the leg side, now Head earns a triple with a flick through mid-wicket. AUSTRALIA INTO THE LEAD.
SCORES ARE LEVEL NOW. Full and around middle, swinging in, ML works it wide of mid on. Lahiru Kumara gives it a good chase but the batsmen take the third on the row.
On a good length outside off, coming back a long way, Marnus knows where his off stump is and lets it go.
Outside off, left alone.
Starts his spell with a NO BALL. The delivery is decent, on a length and just outside off. Labuschagne defends it towards mid on.
Suranga Lakmal to have a final burst before Tea. 15 minutes left. 14-6-32-2 so far.
Full again, well blocked out.
Around middle, watchfully blocked out.
Full and around off, pushed towards the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Full and outside off, Head leans into the shot and eases it through the covers for a single.
On a good length outside off, steered behind point for a run.
Around off, solidly defended.
On a good length outside off, moving away, ML is a touch surprised by the bounce but manages to push it towards gully for a single.
Opportunity missed. Short and wide outside off, Marnus cuts but straight to point.
Good length, just short of full, solidly defended with a nice stride.
A bumper, on off, Labuschagne ducks.
Full and around middle, worked wide of mid-wicket for a quick run. 10 from the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Fine way to raise the 50-run stand. Full and around middle and off, Labuschagne gets down and sweeps it powerfully, to the left of the diving backward square leg fielder for a boundary. The deficit is now 9.

Turn and bounce. Wasn't all that short, but Marnus went on the back foot to turn it to the leg side. The ball skidded on, took the inside edge and hit him on the pads. Luckily for him, it lobbed ahead, instead of towards short leg.
Full and outside off, Labuschagne gets down and across and paddles it fine. Two more to the total.
Short and outside off, Head rocks back and punches it through the covers. By the time Suranga Lakmal can sweep the ground from point to cover, three runs are taken. Head moves to 22.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

LBW shout. Not out. Looked close initially but replays indicate that height could have been an issue. Yes. Now Hawk Eye confirms. On a good length outside off, coming back in, Labuschagne shoulders arms but is hit on the pads. Kumara appeals but Chandimal does not bother reviewing.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Outside off, punched through mid off for three.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for another single.
A touch short, Marnus goes back and works it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller on length, worked straight to short leg again.
Around middle, worked towards short leg.
Full and down the leg side, Head misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads through fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Down the leg side, Travis turns it towards fine leg for a run.
WIDE. Waste of a bouncer. Banged in too short, right in the middle of the pitch. Easy leave for Head.
Full and outside off, eased towards mid off's left for a single. Labuschagne moves to 10.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a good length outside off, left alone.
DRINKS BREAK again. Lahiru Kumara is back on. 12-4-32-1 so far.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, Labuschagne drives it past the bowler through the vacant mid off region. One plus one plus one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot towards the bowler.
Spin time. Dilruwan Perera to bowl. 3-2-4-1 so far. He needs to ensure that the pressure is sustained.

FOUR! Tough luck for Chandimal. His foot was touching the ropes while deflecting the ball. Full and outside off, Head drives this through the covers. Chandimal gives it a good chase, gets to the ball with a slide, tries to push the ball back in but misses. Tries again in the second attempt and this time he is successful. But that is when his foot touches the ropes. The umpires refer it upstairs and it is confirmed.
Is that a four? Dinesh Chandimal has made a lovely save but is he in contact with the rope? The third umpire is getting ready with his answer sheet...
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! MAJESTIC! First confident shot from Head. Full and outside off, Travis leans and drives it through the covers.
On middle and leg, worked through the leg side for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. That man from backward square leg has been moved to square leg.
Nicely timed. On middle and leg, Travis works it through mid-wicket and gets three.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
On a good length around middle, Head tucks it wide of backward square leg and takes a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and down the leg side, TH gets across and looks to flick but misses. The keeper fumbles. A bye taken.
A short ball around middle, Travis tucks it to the leg side.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, left alone.
NO BALL. That is a massive overstepping. Full and outside off, worked to the leg side. 100 UP FOR AUSTRALIA. Still 44 runs adrift.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
A short ball outside off, that barely rises, Marnus looks to pull but mistimes it towards mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a good length around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
A length ball outside off, Labuschagne lets it through.
Lahiru Kumara returns. 10-3-28-1 so far.
Outside off, let through.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Landed outside off, left alone.

EDGED, FOUR! Loose, too loose from Head. Full and wide outside off, Travis goes after the carrot and almost has to pay for it. Gets a thick outside edge but luckily for him, it flies over a leaping second slip. Head immediately punches his bat in anger.
Full again, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Driven towards the mid on region.

Oops... should I play? Should I leave? Oh dear... I almost had to leave the ground. An attempt to look at what might be going in Labuschagne's mind. Full and outside off, Marnus initially comes forward to play. But then, the ball comes back in and he looks to leave. Too late. A bottom edge is induced and the ball goes towards point.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
On a good length outside off, Labuschagne gets forward and across to play but is beaten.
Full and outside off, left alone.

DRINKS BREAK. It has been a good passage of play for Sri Lanka. They got two wickets in the form of Marcus Harris and nightwatchman Nathan Lyon. They have bowled some brilliant lines and lengths and tested the batsmen. Australia have been under pressure and it has been continuous. Something might just give here...
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

OVERTHROWS. Cannot say it was totally needless. A lovely nut to start. Full and around off, Labuschagne gets across to defend but misses. The ball comes back in a long way and hits him on the pads. Chameera appeals for LBW but is turned down as the impact looked to be outside off. Meanwhile, there is some more drama. The ball deflects towards the slip cordon where an alert Kusal Mendis charges in from second slip and has a shy at the striker's end, hoping to catch Labuschagne off guard, who is still working on his huge stride. Unfortunately for Kusal, he misses. The back foot had just made it in the crease. But then, more misfortune arrived. Normally, in Tests, you do not have a mid on. There was none here either. Because the throw missed the stumps, it went through mid on which was vacant. By the time short mid-wicket could track it down, three runs are taken. The deficit is now 49.
OFF THE MARK AFTER 19 BALLS. Around middle, tailing down, Marnus gets across and tucks it through square leg for a couple. The stand moves to 10.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

What. A . Ball. The length is full and the line is outside off. All the necessary ingredients contained in inviting the batsman for a long drive. But Labuschagne is not in the mood. Lets it go. And it is a good decision too. Tell you why. The ball initially curls away but then swings in like a banana. Barely carries to the keeper.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
First bowling change of the day. Dushmantha Chameera to bowl. 7-1-14-0 so far.

There is that booming indipper from Lakmal. Comes in a long way from outside off, Head gets across to play but then shoulders arms. Is hit on the pads but it is too high. Lakmal screams his lungs out but the umpire moves away.
Landed on a good length outside off, pushed towards cover.

FOUR! FIRST RUN OF THE BAT AFTER 34 BALLS. First run after 22 successive dots. Short and outside off, Head flashes hard and cuts it behind point for a boundary! Gets off the mark in style. A rare loose ball.
On a good length outside off, delivered from around the wicket, Head gets across and does what he did on the previous two balls - leave it alone.
Similar ball, same reaction, same result.
Landed on a length outside off, left alone.
Full and just outside off, Labuschagne gets a good stride forward and blocks. Third consecutive maiden over.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
On a good length outside off, ML shoulders arms.
A bouncer around off, slower in pace, Marnus lets it sail through.
Landed outside off, Labuschagne gets a good stride forward and shoulders arms.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended down the track.
This is very, very good bowling from Sri Lanka. Not giving anything away. Around off again, Head tries to maneuver the ball to the leg side, but can only find mid on. Another run-less over.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Landed outside off, nice pace, let through once more.
Full and outside off, not played at again.
One more leave outside off.
Landed outside off, inviting the drive, full and wide, but Head shoulders arms.

Another huge LBW shout. But not out. Kumara is agitated but Chandimal calms him down. No need to waste the second review. The impact looked outside off and Hawk Eye confirms. Good technique shown by Labuschagne. Gets a good stride in, meets the ball on the pitch but misses it, due to the inward movement. Is hit on the pads but his long stride and slight shuffle across save him. Another lovely over. No runs off the bat since ball number 5 of the 27th over. The Sri Lankans are loving the 'Gabba...
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Landed outside off, this one comes back in as well, but ML knows where his off stump is. Shoulders arms.
A bouncer now, but way too high. Marnus ducks.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump again.
Landed outside off, coming in a long way, Labuschagne shoulders arms. That was not far from the off stump.
Outside off, left alone. Superb over from Lakmal.

FOUR BYES! That is a snorter. A real snorter. Banged in short, around middle, Head ducks. Dickwella leaps and tries to get a glove to it but it is just too high above him. Flies away to the fine leg fence. The deficit is now 58.
Travis Head walks in at number 6, replacing Lyon. Two new batsmen in the middle.

OUT! The ball has carried and Lyon has to go! Second wicket in the space of 17 balls this morning. Australia have lost 3/10 in the span of 40 deliveries, if you add Khawaja's dismissal last night. Lovely delivery, full and around off, Nathan looked to defend. However, the away movement consumed him. A thick outside edge was induced which went towards second slip. It was dipping and Kusal Mendis had to dive forward. But he took it cleanly or rather, let us put it this way - he was confident that he had taken it. Lyon was going nowhere though. He wanted it to be checked and the umpires obliged. Not quite sure what the soft signal was but does not matter. One look in the replays was enough to take the right decision. O. U. T. Australia still trail by 62. Can Sri Lanka start thinking about the lead now?
Is that out? Has that carried? Things happening at the 'Gabba. Lyon has edged one but he doesn't think it has carried to second slip. Third umpire intervention time...
Full and outside off, driven sweetly but straight to short extra cover.
Around off, pushed towards point.
Jaffa! Every over is now having a play and a miss first ball. On a length outside off, Lyon looks to defend but the ball moves away late off the seam and beats the outside edge.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around middle, Labuschagne gets across and works it towards square leg.
Outside off, left alone watchfully.

NOT OUT. Impact itself is outside leg. That is a really bad review. One cannot blame Dickwella as he would have been blinded by Lyon. But what about Kumara? It was a full toss which was missed, yes. But still, the ball had some distance to travel. Agreed that the batsman was shuffling across. But that came after playing the shot. Anyways, in the heat of the moment and all the excitement, Kumara probably thought he had Lyon LBW when he missed the flick. But not Hawk Eye.
Huge LBW shout! Not out, says the umpire. Kumara reckons that he has Lyon here. Chandimal takes the review. Looks to be missing leg to the naked eye...
Nearly through him! On a length outside off, Nathan looks to defend but the ball sneaks back in off the pitch, takes the inside edge and almost goes back onto the stumps! The pads come in the way...

FOUR LEG BYES. Goes for the glory ball, does Kumara but ends up dishing it too full, around middle and leg. Lyon looks to flick but misses. However, the ball deflects off his pads past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Landed outside off, little outswing, left alone. Even before Lakmal can take his cap back from the umpire, Lahiru Kumara has his hat off. He is pumped up and eager to bowl straightaway.
Full and outside off, Lyon eases this through the covers for a single.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good start by Lakmal too. He lands this on a good length, outside off, Lyon feels for it but the ball nips away off the seam and beats the outside edge.
Who is in? Marnus Labuschagne it is. Suranga Lakmal to bowl from the other end.

OUT! Caught next ball! Oh wow. This is so, so lucky for Sri Lanka. Bad ball, but a wicket! Short and outside off, Harris latches on to the cut shot and hits it well too. But finds Lahiru Thirimanne at point to perfection! All that watchfulness last evening has come to naught. Harris started on 40 this morning. This is a nice lesson for him to understand that every day, every session, every mini-session and every time you start after a break, you start on 0. Australia trail by 68, Sri Lanka hunting for 7 more wickets.
FOUR! MAGNIFICENT! The most confident shot played by Harris all through his innings. Full and outside off, Marcus leans into the shot, reaches out to meet the ball and strokes it through the covers.
Full and around off, MH looks to drive hard but gets a thick inside edge towards mid on.
Just outside off, Marcus offers a dead-bat defense towards cover.
Full and just around off, watchfully defended.
Good start. On a length outside off, Harris tentatively pushes at it but the ball seams away and whizzes past the outside edge.
We are ready for the game to resume. Marcus Harris will be accompanied by night watchman Nathan Lyon. Lahiru Kumara to start off proceedings to Harris. 6-0-24-0 so far. Here we go...

The visitors may be a long way behind as of now but they need not be disheartened. Given the way Australia's batting has performed in the last few months, there are big chances of them not getting too much of a lead. A one-inning shootout is what they should aim for.

A rare good day it was for the Aussies as they took the game by the scruff of the neck with the pink ball. The match has begun at a fast pace with 12 wickets on Day 1. In a day-night Test, certainly more scalps can be expected on days to follow. Does that mean we could see Sri Lanka batting before the lights take effect? Or will Australia take the match out of Sri Lanka's reach? Hello and a warm welcome to the second day of the opening Test between Australia and Sri Lanka at the 'Gabba.
... DAY 2, AFTERNOON SESSION ...

Is the game over for Sri Lanka? Well, no. Certainly not, we hope! But it might well be, if Australia manage to bat out the whole day of Friday. The fact that they have struggled to play out a whole day consistently in recent times will give the Lankans hope. Can they come out firing on Day 2 and restrict the Aussies under 200? Then, we can really have a contest. Join us for all the action at 1 pm local (0300 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Earlier in the day, a fearsome quick bowling display was there for all to see as Oz nipped the Sri Lankan innings for just 144. Cummins and debutant Jhye were the pick of the bowlers, with 7 scalps between them. The Lankans will be rueing that effort - or lack of it - winning the toss, electing to bat but not even lasting a day.

It was a difficult session for the Aussies under lights, with the pink ball moving around. Marcus Harris never looked settled but ironically, he has batted through the session, on a patient 40. Burns and Khawaja made two trips to the middle and back but neither looked too confident either. Both the stands got a start, but could not be converted.

That last wicket might just spur the Lankans on but it has been Australia's session and Australia's day. After losing the toss, if you can bowl out the opposition in just over 2 sessions and then reduce the deficit by half, you have had a jolly good day.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended. That will be it. STUMPS ON DAY 1, AUSTRALIA TRAIL BY 72!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
